## GKE CPU Utilization Alert (Info/Warning)

CPU request utilization in namespace (<K8S_NAMESPACE>) on GKE cluster (<CLUSTER_NAME>) has exceeded thresholds:
- **Info** (> 60% of CPU request for 10 minutes)
- **Warning** (> 80% of CPU request for 5 minutes)
